summary: Changes tax_for so it returns None for an unknown region. Before this change it returned zero tax.

findings.title: None return breaks both tax_for callers
findings.problem: For an unknown region, tax_for now returns None instead of 0. Both callers do arithmetic on the result without checking for None.
findings.consequence: For any region missing from RATES, order_total in checkout.py raises TypeError on int plus None. The same input makes tax_line in receipt.py raise TypeError on None divided by 100, so checkout and receipts crash.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line to handle None in the same change.

findings.title: Unknown region path has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a new branch in tax_for for unknown regions. No test in the repository exercises tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: No test caught the crash in order_total and tax_line. Future regressions on this path will also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests that call tax_for, order_total and tax_line with an unknown region.
